## About
Auto Essential Dent is a dent repair shop on Allen-Genoa Rd in South Houston, run by owner Carlos Lopez and his son Josue. We focus on paintless dent removal, from a single ding on a truck to hail damage running from hood to trunk.
We explain the process up front, keep you posted while we work, and leave things clean when we're done. One customer told us the car looked so good you'd never know the hail dents had been there. That's the goal every time.

## Services
- Hail damage repair: We work hail dents out of hoods, roofs, doors and trunks so the car looks right again.
- Paintless dent removal: Dents are worked out without repainting, keeping the original finish.
- Vehicle dent repair: Got a dent and no idea where it came from? Tell us about it and we'll give you a price.

## FAQ
Q: Can you do the repair at my house?
A: One customer had the work done at their home and said it made the whole process easy and convenient. Give us a call to ask about your situation.

Q: Do you work with insurance?
A: A reviewer said we worked with their insurance company and financial institution to handle payment on a hail repair.

Q: Can you fit my schedule?
A: We try to work around the time or day that suits you.
